components.name: App runtime
components.description: Recognition, takes, baseline, dictionary revisions and storage; no UI. Engine.kt also holds the model-file and sherpa glue; Recognizer.kt also holds PauseChunker.

components.name: IME and recording
components.description: Voice input method: panel, microphone capture, editor input, recording feedback and microphone permission.

components.name: Settings and dictionary UI
components.description: Settings screen, benchmark storage controls and the dictionary editor (ADR-027).

components.name: Benchmark variant
components.description: Probe activities compiled only into the benchmark build type.

components.name: App unit tests
components.description: Host JVM tests of the app sources.

components.name: App device tests
components.description: Instrumentation tests and replay helpers; compiled by the gate, run on the phone only.

components.name: Phone wrapper and gate
components.description: App-scoped phone wrapper and its sandbox/hook configuration (ADR-024); protected, changed through apply.sh.

components.name: Host tests
components.description: Python unittest suites run by tools/quality.py.

components.name: Host tools
components.description: Laptop-side evaluation, measurement, dictionary and quality scripts.

rules.name: No network
rules.description: R3: the app has no network permission or networking code.

rules.name: No test dependencies in app code
rules.description: Shipped sources must not import test libraries.

rules.name: Layer order
rules.description: A component may depend on the same or a lower layer, never a higher one.
